messages.text:
That is a terrible value discount code for the amount of hassle I have had
to endure starting from when I ordered the NerdQX months ago and I still do
not have any working equipment.
Note to the team: I'll check the order and the return before replying.
Handed to the team · Compensation beyond my $25/$50 code limit needs Abel or Georges, and the warehou

Hi Victor,

You are right, and I am not going to argue the point. A $25 code does not come close to months of waiting with nothing running, and it was never meant to settle this on its own.

Here is the honest state of things. Your Thor P2 is packed and reserved for you at our Chattanooga warehouse on Shop····. The only thing holding it is the receipt on your returned BS-2, which UPS delivered on October 20 and which our receiving team still has not booked in. That booking is not something I can force through from my side, and I am not going to pretend otherwise after three attempts.

So I have put the whole of this in front of Abel and Georges: getting the receipt logged and your Thor P2 released, and the compensation question, which is above what I am allowed to decide on my own. They are offline tonight and pick it up at 10am ET tomorrow, and the answer comes to you right here in this thread, so you do not need to chase it again.

Keep the code in the meantime. It is not the answer to this, just something small on a future order.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
